780K likes, 1,143 comments - yuvisofficial on October 7, 2026: "Very few actors could play such diverse and complex roles the way Nana Patekar ji did. Every character had a distinct voice, emotion and presence, and he made each one his own.

I remember watching so many of his films and being completely drawn in by his performances. His voice, his intensity and his ability to make you feel every emotion were truly special.

Cinema has lost a gem today. A phenomenal actor who will always be remembered. My heartfelt condolences to his family. Om Shanti. 🙏

#NanaPatekar".
